title: The Edge Where All Archives Forget Their Sum

features.name: the counting monument
features.desc-on-touch: A pillar of stacked numbered rings, each one weathered to half-legibility. The numerals blur toward its top, dissolving into grain and lichen. You touch where calculation ends.

features.name: the quiet spiral
features.desc-on-touch: A gyre traced in dust on stone, counted once and then forgotten. The wind erases each spiral as fast as the counting begins. Patient. Without urgency.

features.name: the archive's dropped record
features.desc-on-touch: A ledger lies open, its final column blank. The last entry cuts off mid-sum. Paper curls at the edges, numbers fading into the sound of wind instead of silence.

features.name: the scatter pool's far edge
features.desc-on-touch: Where the water you came from finally learns it has no measure. Arithmetic and water become the same thing here—both in motion, both too plural to count.

inscription: the edge remembers learning: to forget the sum is to hear the wind's reply
